rationale: Builds on the current 9x512 reverse-tail best without changing tokenizer, validation, recurrence order, or artifact format. The quant-aware endgame now also tracks EMA for the last two tail blocks' value projections and MLP input matrices before the final roundtrip, targeting recurrent-tail tensors that still pass through final int8 quantization without increasing artifact bytes or enabling intermediate validation.
title: Tail Value And MLP EMA Endgame
